notes._: Every entry here is an OPEN BUG, not accepted debt: a box whose entire configuration update the server refuses, silently, on every save. The baseline exists so a NEW one blocks -- it is not permission to leave these.
notes.action/wf_act_freeze_habbo: Client FreezeUser.ts sends [effectId, cancelOnTeleport]; the box declares no rules, so every save is refused. ExecuteAsync works and locks movement -- the behaviour is fine, it is unreachable. Its own doc comment says 'No int params', which is what the client contradicts. Fixing the count makes the box saveable; honouring the two params is separate work.
notes.addon/wf_xtra_mov_physics: Client MovePhysics.ts sends four booleans (keep altitude, move through furni, move through users, block by furni); the box declares no rules. It also has no behaviour at all beyond WiredCode, so fixing the count alone changes nothing a player can see.
notes.selector/wf_slc_users_with_var: Client UsersWithVariable.ts inherits VariableSelector.readIntParamsFromForm, which sends 5 (comparison, select-by-value, a two-slot long, target); the box declares 1. Its furni twin wf_slc_furni_with_var declares all 5 -- the asymmetry is the bug.
notes.selector/wf_slc_remote: Client RemoteSelector.ts sends [type, count]; the box declares no rules and has no behaviour beyond WiredCode.
notes.trigger/wf_trg_user_performs_action: Client UserPerformsAction.ts sends one int, the action code; the box declares no rules.
